meta.Context: Bright angel, earthquake, guards like dead men. Angel rolls stone away revealing Jesus is raised from the dead. Women meet Jesus, disciples meet Jesus and receive great commission.

topics.label: Sunday
topics.note: Jesus rose on Sunday (the first day of the week). Jesus appeared to His disciples on resurrection Sunday (John 20:19) and the following Sunday (John 20:26). Pentecost fell on a Sunday and the Holy Spirit was poured out (Acts 2:33) birthing the church, as Israel was birthed at the first Pentecost. All this likely influenced the early church to meet on Sundays (Acts 20:7, 1 Corinthians 16:2) and to call it the Lord's Day (Revelation 1:10).

topics.label: Earthquake
topics.note: Earthquakes upon his death and resurrection.

topics.label: Power properly used
topics.note: The angel had power to incapacitate the guards, but was harmless and helpful to the women who were seeking Jesus' body. God is the source of all power and He is always good.

topics.label: Jesus rose as He predicted
topics.note: Jesus told his disciples that He would be raised on the third day, and He was. This is a powerful confirmation of His identity and the truth of all that He said.
